speaker: abel_garnish
text: Third week. The book is open. I am on the stool. If you mean to grow, Master Kemp, grow where I can see the lines, not after I have shut the page.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Remuneration, Abel. Three farthings. I have them in the hand, I have them in the mouth, and the page is standing there as if he were not the point of the offer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Light. A farthing ought to feel like an insult, and these do. That is the joke, if anyone in a gown still knows a small coin.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I am not for sale, Master Kemp. Not at three farthings, and not if you bite them first.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I shall bite them. A boy should know the coin is real before he refuses it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Real enough to be an insult. Sam, three farthings for the page, and you may keep your dignity at the usual price, which is nothing.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Master Phillips is not here to hear you buy me. I am not going with the farthings. I know the cue without being sold.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Term ends today. The gowns will thin by tomorrow, and a lawyer who is gone to the country cannot be bought with farthings either. I am glad of a quieter yard. I have bows enough.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am not staying in a room to count another man's farthings. Berowne's speech on love wants a wall, and the stable has one. I am taking it there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take it. The room can spare you. Come back when the speech has somewhere to stand.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: That pass was two lines longer than the one before it. I heard the extra. I am not adding the mornings together.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Set down, set down. The groundlings never paid a penny to hear what was set down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Some of it is better than what I wrote. I would be glad to know which, so that I may write it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are very courteous, Will. A courteous man is a man who has felt the yard move and would like the credit for the moving. I will not mark your lines for you. I am busy with mine.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Hold. I have a margin. I am writing a K at the head of it. I am not writing a sum. A sum is a Saturday habit, and this is Wednesday, and Wednesday is not a total.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Write the K, if you must have a head to the column. Do not write a figure under it for my sake. I have not asked for a figure. I have asked which lines are the better ones.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Better is the one that gets the laugh before your next cue buries it. Two lines longer is two lines the yard has time to love. You may call that theft when you are less courteous.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The gowns will thin. What they loved in term they will not all stay to love. I should like the play to survive a yard of ordinary men, not only of students.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I still have the farthings in front of me. I have not taken them. May I go and stand where the cue is, and not where the sale is?

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Go and stand. The K is a letter. It is not your price. Nobody is buying you out of the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again, from the offer. I will hear the two lines, and I will not keep them if they are only noise. Tell me which, Will. I asked so that I might write them, not so that I might lose them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hear them, then. I will not label them. A clown who labels his laughs is already half a book-keeper, and Abel has that stool.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The pass again. Two lines, if they come, I will know. I will not turn them into a number while Dick is still at the wall.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Let him have the wall. A love speech in a stable is still a love speech. The horses have no votes, which is more than I can say for a term-time yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hilary term ends today. I am not going to Westminster to see it end. The thinning will show itself without my help.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then we are agreed. You will be courteous, Abel will be alphabetical, and I will be two lines longer until the yard tells me to stop. The yard is the only master I came here to please.
